Pizza Hut is on a mission to be the first choice for Australians when it comes to great pizza shared with family and friends. We’re looking for a driven and experienced Store Manager to lead our North Brisbane restaurant and deliver outstanding results across operations, people, and customer experience.

This is a hands-on leadership role where you will take full ownership of the restaurant’s performance, team development, and day-to-day operations.

About the role

As Store Manager, you will:

• Lead, coach, and motivate your team to deliver exceptional customer service and uphold Pizza Hut brand standards

• Manage recruitment, onboarding, and ongoing training of team members

• Drive sales growth through strong execution of promotions and local store marketing initiatives

• Ensure CHAMPS standards are consistently achieved across customer service, hygiene, and product quality

• Maintain compliance with company policies, food safety standards, and audit requirements

• Manage labour and food costs to meet profitability targets

• Monitor and analyse sales performance to identify opportunities for improvement

• Handle employee relations and operational issues in line with company procedures

• Approve and control store expenditure within set guidelines

About you

You will bring:

• Proven leadership experience in a fast-paced hospitality or retail environment

• Strong commercial awareness with the ability to interpret sales and cost data

• A hands-on leadership style with the ability to motivate and develop teams

• Excellent communication and problem-solving skills

• The ability to stay calm under pressure and manage competing priorities

• A high level of accountability, initiative, and drive

What we offer

• Competitive salary package

• Performance-based incentives

• Ongoing training and development opportunities

• Career progression within a growing franchise network

• Support from an experienced operations team

Salary: $79500.00 to $82000.00 Yearly and 12% Superannuation

•	Developing mitigation measures, rehabilitation strategies, and environmental management recommendations based on ecological and environmental assessments.
•	Liaising with project teams, contractors, stakeholders, and environmental authorities regarding environmental compliance and biodiversity management matters.

•	Relevant qualification or a closely related field.
•	At least 3 years of experience.
•	Demonstrated ability to conduct environmental assessments, analyse scientific data, and prepare accurate technical reports in accordance with relevant legislation and industry standards. 
•	Strong knowledge of environmental management principles, ecological assessment methodologies, environmental monitoring techniques, and applicable Australian environmental legislation and compliance requirements. 
•	Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, prioritise competing tasks, and meet reporting and project deadlines in a fast-paced consulting or field-based environment.
